title: Run archive object, sagat-run-archive-v1 (draft)
description: An archive is two objects per run under `<prefix>/sagat-run-archive-v1/t=<tenant>/ns=<namespace>/dt=<finished UTC date>/<runId>`: `<runId>.ndjson.gz` (gzip, one JSON value per line: line 1 is the header, then one line per journal event in sequence order, then one `payload` line per distinct retained payload within the policy) and `<runId>.manifest.json` (this schema's `manifest`). The names are deterministic, so a retried export rewrites the same objects with identical bytes. Verification compares the stored size and SHA-256 of the data object with the manifest before any hot data is deleted (FR-020-033). The document model is the history export's (run-history.schema.json): an archived run exported later gives the same `digest`. Under the PLATFORM destination the prefix is `tenants/<tenant>/namespaces/<namespace>/archive` in the platform blob store (ADR-0023 key rules).

blobs.description: Descriptors of the run's committed blobs. Bytes are not archived in v1 (G1088).

definition.description: The `definition` object of sagat-run-history-v1, with the IR document.

searchAttributes.description: Final values, each within valuesLevel; others withheld.

event.description: One element of sagat-run-history-v1 `events` (payload as a reference).

value.description: The payload projected to valuesLevel with FR-016-009 withheld nodes; absent for METADATA_ONLY. `secret` nodes are always withheld.
